Diagnostic markers delimit publisher callbacks and loader finish before its clock query. Writes before finish/outside publisher show overlap with the live loading call, including remaining diagnostic overhead. The separate query and delivery times are checked against independent native HV reads. No deadline acceptance gate; no DMA/native IRQ/input/boot/full-game/hardware proof. Publisher consumes due FIFO events with source_psg_queue_take_many: one queue validation and cursor release per batch, original enqueue/plan/transport remain active.

Synchronous polled transfer prepares once per call and retries only WAIT up to the configured attempt limit. Diagnostic grant_wait counts exhausted outer calls, not internal transfer attempts; FULL/errors return immediately. No deferred queue or source work runs inside the polling loop.

Video service experiment wraps the selected source_clock function boundaries (all four, both repetition functions, or only repeat_disabled) and attempts DMA every configured number of boundaries. Inline source_clock_block and computation inside helpers are not serviced. Adds native cost without changing the logical source clock; no maximum service interval or frame deadline is established.
Native PSG-word diagnostic markers add writes outside the checked Z80 source-byte stream; these kernels measure source-byte transport/timing and do not establish an unmodified audio waveform.
